title: Content Repurposer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 52. Takes one existing long-form asset (typically function 46's newsletter or function 47's case study) and repurposes it into 2-3 shorter derivative social formats, each roof-lined, pillar-tagged and carrying its own CTA.

source_asset_summary.description: A client-free summary of the existing long-form asset being repurposed.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value shared by every derivative's call to action.

target_formats.description: The 1-3 shorter derivative formats to produce from the source asset.

client_reference.description: Optional client name the caller wants named. Only used if docs/permission-register.yaml confirms CLEARED status; otherwise every derivative is written client-free.

derivatives.description: One derivative per requested target format, in the same order as target_formats.
